svg.title: Single EKS cluster with node-group isolation and Karpenter autoscaling
svg.desc: One EKS cluster running CI/CD, application, and monitoring namespaces, each scheduled onto its own Karpenter-managed node pool via taints and tolerations, with a Karpenter controller provisioning and scaling nodes per pool.
svg.text: Single EKS cluster — node-group isolated workloads, Karpenter autoscaling

Each workload group runs on its own Karpenter NodePool — pods get a nodeSelector + toleration matching the pool's taint, so CI/CD, app, and monitoring pods never land on the same node and each pool scales independently.
